gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Ruler-straight and bold, Happy Monkey looks cut with one blade. Chiron Hei HK, a modern sans with a c opened wide like a bracelet, gives that heading somewhere quiet to rest.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Stamped, not written: Happy Monkey has ruler-straight strokes and no pressure swells where the eye might slow. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi, a plain sans, keeps every small counter open.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Drawn-wire weight and ruler-straight lines: that's Happy Monkey. Sawarabi Gothic, a sans with open jaws on every curve, can sit at a modest size beneath it and stay legible.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-arsenal-: Ballpoint-plain and expressive, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its terminals pointing outward, with no pressure. Use it big and short; Arsenal SC, a tight sans-serif, handles the rest.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-menbere: Plain-lined and expressive, Love Ya Like A Sister stays low and level. Menbere, a sans whose lowercase stacks tall like rolled cord, handles the steady reading while the heading handles the shouting.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-ubuntu: Plain as stitched thread, Love Ya Like A Sister still sounds expressive. Ubuntu, a modern sans-serif with a lofty lowercase band, lends the pair a confident, upright stance against that low-slung heading.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-viga: Viga, a neutral sans-serif with hairline-free strokes and a capital barely taller than its neighbors, speaks in a flat, plain voice. Love Ya Like A Sister brings the swagger, and that is the appeal.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-voces: Love Ya Like A Sister draws pipe-cleaner strokes with outward-pointing tips. Voces, a plain sans built tall, adds the slight reed-pen thickening in its curves that the heading lacks.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-synonym: Soft watercolor shifts in weight give Metamorphous its commanding look. Synonym, a dependable sans-serif in constant ink with generous curves, makes the heading's quiet weight shifts the pair's main draw.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-rambla: Commanding at size, Metamorphous has a high midline and soft strokes. Shrink the heading and its presence fades, while Rambla, a sans-serif with near-capital lowercase, holds up at nearly any size.
